result.instructions: Tools for Staffwise, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What shifts are booked for job 1234 between 1 and 30 November?"; "Show me the shift report for job 1234 for last week.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Staffwise data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run staffwise_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run staffwise_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run staffwise_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. staffwise_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: staffwise_get_shifts
tools.title: Get shifts for a job
tools.description: Read the shift details that Staffwise reports for one job over a date range. Use a job id from Jobs > View Jobs. Staffwise API: POST /api/campaigns/get-data/{job-id}. The response is returned as the vendor sent it.

jobId.description: The Staffwise job id (the ID column in Jobs > View Jobs).
